name: Killing Boys
source:
[i][b]Work is murder, but revenge is sweet! xoxo[/b][/i]
 
Play as EVE, an immortal assassin cursed with the kiss of death, as she turns on her (literal) evil corporate overlords in an attempt to break free of her iron-clad contract. Experience betrayal, commit murder, and pursue romance in a story that spans eras.

[Edited from [url=https://www.firstbitegames.com/killingboys]official website[/url]]
translation:
[i][b]工作简直要命，复仇却甜蜜！亲亲[/b][/i]

扮演EVE，一名被“死亡之吻”诅咒的永生刺客。她反抗（字面意义上的）邪恶公司高层，试图挣脱牢不可破的契约。在跨越多个时代的故事中，经历背叛、实施谋杀，并追寻爱情。

[改写自[url=https://www.firstbitegames.com/killingboys]官方网站[/url]]
